locator: I q.2 a.3 co., secunda via: et medium est causa ultimi, sive media sint plura sive unum tantum
interpretation: In ordered efficient causes the middle is the cause of the last. Read as: whatever causes x as caused (a middle cause of x, CausesAsCaused) efficiently causes x in some respect. This is part of the meaning of the per se link (DEF-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-LINK: c efficiently causes x only insofar as c is caused), stated as its own premise because CausesAsCaused is a Lean parameter.
